title: PPG gets $97.9M permit for first phase of 728-unit Palm Aire rental project in North Miami Beach
summary: PPG Development, led by Ari Pearl, secured a $97.9M permit for an eight-story and a six-story apartment building plus retail and garage on Lot 1 of its 728-unit Palm Aire project at 1750 NE 167th St. In September PPG and partners closed $235M in construction financing, including a $205M loan from BDT & MSD Partners. PPG bought the site for $31.1M in April 2022.

title: Juwan Howard sells Coral Gables mansion for $25M; Whiteside nets $12.6M in Miami Beach
summary: Juwan Howard sold his 9,000-SF Kobi Karp-designed home at 9440 Old Cutler Lane for $25M, or $2,777 per SF, to attorney Patrick Collins. It was listed at $31.5M and went under contract at $28.9M in September; Howard paid $3.4M in 2013. Hassan Whiteside's 5,400-SF Miami Beach home at 528 Lakeview Court sold for $12.6M, or $2,333 per SF.

title: Ralgo Group pays $53.5M for 267-unit Treetop Apartments in Miami, $200,375/unit
summary: An entity led by Amy and Richard Gonzalez of Ralgo Group bought the 267-unit Treetop Apartments at 8520 SW 107th Ave for $53.5M, or $200,375 per unit. The seller, Residences at 107 Ave. Inc., paid $8.5M in 1995. The 283,700-SF, three-story complex sits on 9.2 acres, was built in 1974 and has two pools; units are listed at $1,750 per month.

title: Blue Spruce Capital family office buys Fisher Island penthouse for $37.5M
summary: Alicia Louise Jarrett's ALJ Properties USA sold a 9,900-SF, seven-bedroom central lower penthouse at 6800 Fisher Island Drive for $37.5M, a steep discount off the original ask. The buyer is an entity managed by Blue Spruce Capital, the family office of energy entrepreneur Michael Smith. Separately, a Glenn Boyer company paid $34.8M for the half-acre lot at 50 West Di Lido Drive, up 26.5% from its 2024 price of $27.5M.

title: Garden Communities affiliate wins Don King's 53-acre Palm Beach fronton with $56.1M bid
summary: K&K Developers, a Garden Communities affiliate, submitted the winning $56.1M all-cash bid at a Nov. 6 bankruptcy auction for the 53-acre Palm Beach Jai Alai site at 1415 45th Street in Mangonia Park, vacant for 32 years. The stalking-horse bid was $55M. Court approval is set for Nov. 12 with a sale Nov. 30; the town has floated up to 2,000 residences.

title: Romanian developer One United injects $43M into Ora by Casa Tua Brickell condo-hotel
summary: One United Properties joined Fortune International's Edgardo Defortuna as JV partner on Ora by Casa Tua, a 77-story, 533-unit condo-hotel planned at 1210 Brickell Avenue, providing $43M in two tranches. The project is about 40% presold at roughly $1,700 to $2,000 per SF. Construction, once slated for 2024, is now expected to start next year.

title: NFL Hall of Famer Fran Tarkenton buys Palm Beach waterfront mansion for $51.9M
summary: Fran Tarkenton paid $51.9M for the 8,720-SF waterfront house at 1620 South Ocean Boulevard, about $5,950 per SF, from Anthony and Lynda Lomangino, who paid $12.7M in 2019 and then remodeled the interior. The 2006-built home has seven bedrooms on 0.67 acres. Christian Angle held the listing; Jana Scarpa of Compass represented Tarkenton.

title: Netscape's Jim Clark buys Palm Beach waterfront compound for $100M off-market
summary: Netscape co-founder Jim Clark and his wife bought the Palm Beach waterfront compound at 1030 North Lake Way from auto mogul David Fischer for $100M off-market, per the Wall Street Journal. That works out to $8,000 per SF across an 8,500-SF main house (built 1998) and a 4,000-SF guest house (built 2025). The Fischers paid $5.3M for the main half-acre in 2000 and $6.8M for the adjacent lot in 2021.

title: Related, BH, Pebb land $140.7M Wells Fargo loan for 494-unit Boca Raton rental project
summary: Wells Fargo provided $140.7M and assumed the existing $35.8M debt, for a total $176.5M loan on Broken Sound Residences at the former Office Depot campus, 6600 North Military Trail in Boca Raton. The eight-story project will have 494 rentals, including 50 workforce units, with construction started last month and completion expected in 2028. Related bought the site for $50M last year.

title: Playboy puts Miami Beach's 89-room Freehand hotel under contract at $12.5M for private club
summary: A Playboy affiliate has the 89-room Freehand Miami hotel at 2701-2731 Indian Creek Drive under contract for $12.5M from a Generator affiliate, per the South Florida Business Journal. It last sold in January 2012 for $12M. Closing is expected by Dec. 15. Playboy plans to put up $5M toward the purchase, recouping it through membership sales, and has a non-binding term sheet for a JV with third-party investors.

title: Bal Harbour Shops' 200,000-SF West Shops expansion fully leased
summary: Bal Harbour Shops' 200,000-SF west wing is fully leased with 30 retailers, including mall debuts for Tom Ford, Khaite, Elie Saab and Boucheron, rolling out through 2028. The 500,000-SF mall will have 140 tenants and reports sales of $2,000 to $3,000 per SF, with gross sales nearing $1B, up 35% since 2020. Whitman is still pursuing a separate Live Local Act tower proposal.

title: CP Group, Georgetown buy back Boca Raton's Mizner Park from Brookfield
summary: CP Group, the Georgetown Company, ACRE and StepStone bought the 838,840-SF Mizner Park mixed-use district in Boca Raton from Brookfield Properties, with Blackstone providing financing. Price was not disclosed. The property has about 268,390 SF of office, 276,460 SF of retail and 272 apartments, and the buyers plan facade, infrastructure and apartment renovations. East Boca retail vacancy was 4.5% in Q3, per Colliers.

title: Welltower pays $208.2M for five Broward, Palm Beach nursing homes
summary: Welltower-linked entities paid $160M for three Broward nursing homes and $48.2M for two in Palm Beach County, buying from companies managed by David Katz of TL Management. The largest was Wilton Manors Health & Rehab at $58.7M ($399,320 per bed, 147 beds). Fort Lauderdale Health & Rehabilitation sold for $52.2M ($308,875 per bed). Colliers cites $975M of Florida senior housing sales through Q2.

title: Welltower pays $49.1M ($570/SF) for Miramar nursing center
summary: An entity linked to Welltower paid $49.1 million for the 86,000-SF Glades West Rehab & Nursing Center at 15955 Bass Creek Road in Miramar, about $570 per SF, per Vizzda. The seller was linked to David Katz. The 3.7-acre, 120-unit property was built in 2015 and last sold for $1.8 million in 2011. In Delray Beach, a Fortress-linked entity paid $25.8 million ($200/SF) for the 146-bed Symphony at Delray Beach senior living community.

title: Rug designer Ben Soleimani buys Palm Beach Polo mansion for $6M
summary: Ben Soleimani paid $6 million, about $1,020 per SF, for a 5,900-SF, four-bedroom home at 12446 Cypress Island Way in Wellington's Palm Beach Polo and Country Club. It was listed at $6.5 million. The sellers, owners of Adelson Galleries, paid $5.9 million in 2021. Equestrian demand is also drawing developers, including Joe Farrell's 27-home Farrell Estates priced from $5M to $10M.

title: Florida voters approve Amendment 3, raising homestead exemption to $150K in 2027
summary: About 62% of voters backed Amendment 3 as of 10:25 p.m. on election night; it needed 60%. The homestead exemption rises from $50,000 to $150,000 in 2027 and $250,000 in 2028, then indexes to CPI. Annual assessment increases on non-homesteaded property, including commercial real estate, are capped at 5%, down from 10%. Florida Realtors endorsed it; the Florida Policy Institute estimated nearly $12 billion in recurring local revenue losses.
